title: node:crypto argon2Sync
notes: Standard-library baseline: argon2Sync("argon2id", { message, nonce, memory, passes, parallelism, tagLength }), returning a Buffer. The password string is encoded to UTF-8 by the call; prepare turns the hex salt into a Buffer once. Node 24.7+ and Bun; Deno's node:crypto has no argon2Sync.
